## Behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal synthetic input and the exact commands needed to reproduce the issue.

## Environment

Include the public release or commit, Python version, operating system and relevant dependency versions.

## Results

Include relevant error codes, validation findings and test output. Remove private paths and sensitive values.

Do not include credentials, real conversation archives, private attachments or personal records. Security vulnerabilities follow SECURITY.md rather than public issue reporting.
